units.source_text: 妹尼僧看见了，戏言道：“你说起‘二杉’，大概是有希望‘再相见’的人吧。”

en.t: The younger nun saw this and said jokingly, "When you speak of 'two cedars,' perhaps there is someone you hope to meet again."

units.source_text: 这话触及了浮舟的心事，她心惊肉跳，脸色立刻变红了。

en.t: These words touched Ukifune's secret thoughts, and she was startled to the core; her face at once flushed red.
The sight of her then was truly very delicate and beautiful.
